description: This file defines an interface for processing and managing savings account applications within the Fineract system. It includes methods for submitting, modifying, approving, rejecting, and withdrawing applications, as well as handling G-SIM (Government-Sponsored Initiative Module) related applications.

classes.name: SavingsApplicationProcessWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for processing savings account application operations, including submission, modification, approval, rejection, and withdrawal, as well as G-SIM application handling.

methods.name: submitApplication
methods.description: Submits a new savings account application based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: modifyApplication
methods.description: Modifies an existing savings account application identified by savingsId, using the data provided in JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteApplication
methods.description: Deletes a savings account application identified by savingsId.

methods.name: approveApplication
methods.description: Approves a savings account application identified by savingsId.

methods.name: undoApplicationApproval
methods.description: Reverses the approval of a savings application identified by savingsId.

methods.name: rejectApplication
methods.description: Rejects a savings account application identified by savingsId.

methods.name: applicantWithdrawsFromApplication
methods.description: Allows the applicant to withdraw from a savings application identified by savingsId.

methods.name: createActiveApplication
methods.description: Creates an active savings application with details provided in SavingsAccountDataDTO.

methods.name: submitGSIMApplication
methods.description: Submits a G-SIM application based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: approveGSIMApplication
methods.description: Approves a G-SIM application identified by gsimId.

methods.name: rejectGSIMApplication
methods.description: Rejects a G-SIM application identified by gsimId.

methods.name: undoGSIMApplicationApproval
methods.description: Reverses the approval of a G-SIM application identified by gsimId.

methods.name: modifyGSIMApplication
methods.description: Modifies a G-SIM application identified by gsimId.
